description: This file defines the GuzzleStream class which adapts a PSR-7 Stream to a Guzzle 5 Stream within the AWS SDK for PHP. It implements an interface and uses a trait, serving as a bridge between different stream representations.

classes.name: GuzzleStream
classes.description: A class that adapts a PSR-7 Stream to a Guzzle 5 Stream, implementing GuzzleStreamInterface and using the StreamDecoratorTrait.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GuzzleStream with a PSR-7 Stream instance.
